headline: Cassava Technologies Seeks $1 Billion to Accelerate African AI
summary: Cassava Technologies is seeking to raise $1 billion to fund data centres and artificial intelligence infrastructure across Africa.
why: Cassava is one of Africa's largest digital infrastructure providers, operating fibre networks and data centres vital for internet connectivity and AI adoption.

impacts.name: Cassava Technologies
impacts.why: The $1 billion funding campaign will finance regional AI server installations and data centre expansion.
